description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mobile Engineer (Member of Technical Staff) based in United States . 

 We are looking for an experienced Mobile Engineer to build and shape a next-generation mobile experience for an open-source AI agent platform. As the first mobile engineering hire, you will take ownership of the mobile product from the ground up, developing and shipping applications for both iOS and Android. You will turn sophisticated AI agent capabilities into intuitive, high-performance experiences that users can access and manage from anywhere. Working closely with product, design, and platform engineering, you will influence technical architecture, establish development standards, and drive features from initial concept through production. This is a hands-on opportunity to make key technical decisions, contribute to an evolving open-source ecosystem, and help define how people interact with personal AI agents in their everyday lives.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Build, launch, and maintain high-quality mobile applications for both iOS and Android, delivering polished and consistent experiences across devices and operating system versions.



 
 Develop core mobile features that enable users to interact with, configure, manage, and communicate with their AI agents.



 
 Own features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to testing, release, and continuous improvement.



 
 Build and optimize real-time interactions, messaging, notifications, and agent communication experiences.



 
 Contribute to mobile architecture and technical direction, creating scalable and maintainable infrastructure for an expanding ecosystem of agents, tools, and integrations.



 
 Integrate mobile applications with backend services, APIs, and agent communication protocols.



 
 Develop reliable solutions for background processing, state management, synchronization, and offline functionality.



 
 Optimize performance, responsiveness, battery consumption, memory usage, and network efficiency across both platforms.



 
 Implement secure authentication, session management, permissions, and data-handling practices, addressing the privacy and security requirements of AI-powered applications.



 
 Establish robust testing, monitoring, logging, debugging, and quality standards to support reliable releases.



 
 Collaborate with product designers, platform engineers, and the wider open-source community to deliver cohesive experiences and improve the platform.



 
 Contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, documentation, engineering standards, and open-source development.




 Requirements:


 
 At least 6 years of professional experience building and shipping production-ready mobile applications.



 
 Demonstrated experience developing for both iOS and Android, with a strong understanding of each platform's architecture, capabilities, and development requirements.



 
 Hands-on native development experience with Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android.



 
 Proven experience publishing and maintaining applications through both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.



 
 Strong knowledge of mobile architecture, state management, API integrations, and asynchronous programming.



 
 Experience working with REST APIs, WebSockets, real-time communication, and backend services.



 
 Solid understanding of mobile performance optimization, debugging, testing, and release management.



 
 Experience implementing authentication, secure data storage, permissions, and mobile application security.



 
 Ability to deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while taking advantage of platform-specific functionality and usability patterns.



 
 Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver reliable code.



 
 Good product instincts and attention to detail, with a passion for creating intuitive and polished mobile experiences.



 
 Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements and a high degree of responsibility.



 
 Experience building AI-powered applications, AI assistants, or agentic products; familiarity with LLM integrations, streaming responses, tool calling, and real-time agent interactions would be an advantage.



 
 Additional assets include experience with background tasks, push notifications, deep linking, mobile-to-device communication, open-source projects, Linux, self-hosted infrastructure, developer tooling, and applications that integrate with local devices or external services.




 Benefits:


 
 Fully remote position, available to candidates based in Canada.



 
 Full-time employment.



 
 Compensation range of $200,000–$300,000.



 
 Opportunity to take ownership of a mobile product from its earliest stages and influence its technical direction.



 
 The chance to contribute to a growing open-source AI ecosystem and collaborate with a broader developer community.
